title: Keep shared-worker Calibration delay explicit

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Shared worker tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/processing/test_shared_worker.py

evidence_required: FT-002-AC-005 RED: no narrow worker boundary can represent a Calibration hold while preserving visible Photo backlog and later resume; GREEN: a controlled calibration operation holds the singleton worker, pending Photos remain ordinary SLO open/breach observations, no Photo claim overlaps and release resumes normal terminal processing; decisive comparison: operation timeline, claim count and SLO rows match with no priority/preemption/second worker; artifact: shared-worker timeline and controlled database projection.
purpose: Expose the narrow accepted Calibration hold on the same worker while keeping Photo backlog and SLO impact truthful.
success_outcome: A controlled Calibration operation holds the singleton worker without preemption, queued Photos remain visible in ordinary SLO accounting and processing resumes after release.
anti_goals: Do not implement Calibration calculations, recommendations, persistent run state, priorities, pause/resume, preemption or a second worker.
Do not create a generic scheduler or operation framework around the runtime-status singleton.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
stop_conditions: The accepted hold cannot be expressed through the narrow current_operation boundary.
Proof would require implementing FT-011 behavior or adding scheduling infrastructure.

constraints: Use only a controlled test operation named calibration; do not persist or compute a Calibration run.
Photo backlog remains ordinary pending/open or aged breach while held.
Release the test operation and clean only task-owned state.
invariants: One worker means Calibration and Photo processing never overlap.
No preemption, priority or alternate queue is introduced.
Photo processing resumes automatically after the narrow hold releases.
verification_targets: Controlled hold records current operation, visible backlog/SLO effect, absence of Photo claims during hold and ordinary terminal progress after release.
